examples.en: I like a light spritzer in the heat.

examples.sr: [Гѐмишт] се прави од вина и минералне воде.
examples.en: A spritzer is made from wine and mineral water.
Tesla was a real genius.
My brother is a math genius.
In geography class we learn the rivers of Serbia.
He knows geography very well.
Our motto is: all or nothing.
The school has a new slogan about knowledge.
Grandma makes gibanica for the slava.
The gibanica has cheese and eggs.
My son goes to gymnasium.
She finished gymnasium in Belgrade.
Book an appointment with the gynecologist.
My gynecologist works at the health center.

examples.sr: Сломио је ногу и сада је у [ги̏псу].
examples.en: He broke his leg and is in a cast now.
They'll take my cast off in three weeks.
A string of lights is hanging in the window.
Turn on the lights on the Christmas tree.
Our guitarist plays every Saturday.
The band is looking for a new guitarist.

note: masculine, but declines like «жена»: gen. гитаристе

examples.en: Take one onion.
I bought two heads of garlic.
"To work" is a verb.

examples.sr: [Гла̏гол] се мења по лицима и временима.
examples.en: A verb changes by person and tense.
We put a bouquet of gladioli on the table.
Gladioli bloom in summer.
She polishes the parquet floor every Saturday.
Dad is polishing the car before the trip.
The music is too loud.
He has a loud laugh.
Turn the volume down, the neighbors are sleeping.
The TV volume is too high.
The audience applauded.
The show has a lot of viewers.
I sprained my ankle on the stairs.
My ankle hurts after running.
The glacier is melting because of warming.
We saw a huge glacier in Alaska.
Sweets damage tooth enamel.
Protect your enamel with toothpaste.
Pots are made of clay.
After rain, clay is slippery.
Worms come out after the rain.
He is as thin as a rake.
This wardrobe is too bulky.
We couldn't bring in the bulky furniture.
I don't tolerate gluten well.
This bread contains no gluten.
Snakes are reptiles.
A reptile lives in the terrarium.
What year were you born?
They were born in the same year.

note: «које си годиште?» asks about age, by birth year

examples.en: The goalkeeper saved the penalty.

examples.sr: Наш [го̏лман] је био најбољи на терену.
examples.en: Our goalkeeper was the best on the field.
I feel proud of my son.

examples.sr: [Го́рдо̄ст] му не дозвољава да тражи помоћ.
examples.en: His pride doesn't let him ask for help.
He's upstairs, on the next floor.
I feel worse today than yesterday.

note: also the comparative of «лоше»: горе = worse

examples.sr: Ситуација је [го̏ра] него што сам мислио.
examples.en: The situation is worse than I thought.

examples.sr: Ово је [го̏рӣ] филм који сам видео.
examples.en: This is the worst movie I've seen.

note: irregular comparative of «лош»; the adverb is «горе»

examples.en: At the campsite we have a gas burner.
The cooking burner is small.

note: «гасни горионик» is a gas burner; a stove is «шпорет»

examples.en: Bitterness remained after the quarrel.
She felt a bitter taste in her mouth.
Serbs are known for their hospitality.
Thank you for your hospitality.
Serbs are very hospitable.
Their family is very hospitable.
Maja is really nice.
This is really cool!

note: slang; said of people and things

examples.en: I don't like him.
I liked her right away.
Obesity is a serious problem.
Doctors warn about obesity.
He who rises early grabs two pieces of luck (the early bird gets the worm).
The kids are grabbing cakes off the plate.

note: from the proverb about getting up early

examples.en: Rake up the leaves with a rake.
Where is the rake?
The lion is a large predator.
Predators hunt at night.
Crows are cawing in the old tree.

examples.sr: Чуло се како [гра̏чу] вране изнад поља.
examples.en: You could hear crows cawing over the field.
Add a sprig of rosemary to the roast.
A bird landed on a small twig.
I got the coffee for free.
The third T-shirt is free.
We bought timber for the roof.
The store sells building materials and tools.
We gathered dry branches for the fire.
The storm broke the branches on the trees.
The national coat of arms is on the flag.
Grandma has a hunched back from old age.
The mother scolded the child.
Don't scold him, it's not his fault.
The cat sharpens its claws on the scratching post.
We bought a new scratching post.
The cat is scratching at the door.
I have to scrape the ice off the windshield.

related.en: to scrape off, to scrape together

examples.en: A wooden beam holds up the roof.
A thick beam runs across the room.
It's a shame to throw away so much bread.
Such talent, it would be a pity to waste it!

note: colloq.: «греота је да...» it's a pity to...

examples.en: Turn on the heater, it's cold in the room.
We have a small heater in the bathroom.
How do you heat your home in winter?
We heat with wood.

note: «на шта се грејете?» means how do you heat your home?

examples.en: Grapefruit juice is bitter.
We'll share one grapefruit.
I make semolina porridge for the kids' breakfast.
The cake is made of semolina.
We got some snacks ready for the movie.

examples.sr: На столу су чипс и друге [грѝцкалице].
examples.en: There are chips and other snacks on the table.
Do you want to take a bite of the cake?
He took a bite of the apple and threw it away.

tips: Also «to grab a quick bite»: грицнућу нешто и идем. Грицкалица, a light snack with drinks, comes from it.

examples.en: Kids love to hug their mom.
They hugged each other at parting.
The friends are hugging at the station.
The kids hug when they meet.
A bird built its nest in a bush.
A noise came from behind the bush.
It's thundering and lightning outside.
Music is booming from the neighborhood.
There was loud thunder last night.
The dog is afraid of thunder.
The grape harvest starts in September.
The whole family goes to the grape harvest.
The pig is grunting in the pigsty.

examples.sr: Деца се шале и [гро̀кћу] као свиње.
examples.en: The kids are joking and oinking like pigs.
A lightning rod has been installed on the roof.
The building has a lightning rod.
Loud thunder could be heard.
The dog is afraid of thunder.
He threw a snowball at his friend.
She made a big snowball.
The kids are having a snowball fight in the yard.
Let's have a snowball fight!
I got a cramp in my leg.
The swimmer got a cramp in the water.
Don't wrinkle the shirt.
Linen wrinkles easily.
Lunch is goulash with potatoes.
Grandma makes the best goulash.
Put on your rubber boots, there are puddles outside.
I bought rubber boots for the kids.
Lend me an eraser for my pencil.
She tied her hair with a hair tie.
Don't be so grumpy.
My grandfather is grumpy in the morning.
The children played pirates.
The pirate has a black patch over his eye.
There is a green caterpillar on the leaves.
The caterpillar will turn into a butterfly.

note: also means a tank or bulldozer track

examples.en: Grandpa sings epic songs to the gusle.
He plays the gusle perfectly.

note: a symbol of Serbian epic poetry

examples.en: Honey has a higher density than water.
Population density is low here.
He had a choking attack at night.
Smoke can cause suffocation.
Inflammation of the pancreas is painful.
The doctor wants an ultrasound of the pancreas.
On weekends I bask on the terrace.
The cat is basking in the sun.
Some fungi are poisonous.
Scientists study fungi in the soil.
Don't be a pest, you keep asking the same thing.
My colleague is a real pain.
- Do you know him? - Of course!
Of course I'll come.

note: slightly old-fashioned or jokey; older people like to say it

examples.en: We ordered mussels buzara-style.
Fresh mussels are sold at the market.
We cook mussels in white wine.
Fresh mussels arrive from the coast.
My grandfather is farsighted.

examples.sr: Она је [далеко̀вида] и чита са наочарима.
examples.en: She is farsighted and reads with glasses.
Red dahlias are blooming in the garden.
Every autumn Grandma plants dahlias.
Don't be a slacker, help me.
He lies around all day like a slacker.

note: colloq., for a man or a woman

examples.en: I loafed on the couch all day.

examples.sr: Није време да [да̀нгубиш], рок је сутра.
examples.en: It's no time to idle, the deadline is tomorrow.
He is very generous to his friends.
She was a generous hostess.
He likes to give gifts to his friends.
We give them books as gifts.
Save the file to the desktop.
This file is too big to send.

forms: comp. of далеко: далеко, даље, најдаље

examples.en: Keep going, don't stand here.
What happened next?
The family invited the neighbors to the memorial meal.
After the funeral there was a memorial meal.

examples.sr: Чир на [дванаестопа̀лачном цре̏ву] боли на празан стомак.
examples.en: A duodenal ulcer hurts on an empty stomach.
The stomach continues into the duodenum.
Look through the binoculars.
We took binoculars to the mountain.
He is two-faced with everyone.
I hate two-faced people.
We put a loveseat in the small apartment.
A loveseat and two armchairs make up the set.
My family lives in a two-room apartment.
We're looking for a two-room apartment with a terrace.

note: counts the living room: living room + 1 bedroom

examples.sr: Дуго се [дво̀умим] да ли да идем.
examples.en: I've been hesitating for a long time about whether to go.
Don't hesitate, say yes!

tips: More expressive than «сумњати»: «није се двоумила ни секунд» - she didn't hesitate for a second. Often «двоумити се да ли да» + present.

examples.en: I have one 2 in my grade book.
The number 2 is coming, don't hurry.

note: also the No. 2 tram or bus

examples.en: Water is absorbed in the large intestine.
The doctor suspects inflammation of the colon.
The wall is thirty centimeters thick.
The ice on the lake is thick enough.
My brother-in-law lives abroad.
At the wedding the groom's brother gave a speech.

note: husband's brother; an honored role at a wedding

examples.en: Foreign currency is exchanged here.
He keeps his savings in foreign currency.
I opened a foreign-currency account.
Foreign-currency savings are safer.
That girl lives next to us.
What a cute girl!
We're going to taste wine in the cellar.
We tasted the cheese before buying.
The doctor on duty came at once.
Today Marko is on duty in class.

examples.sr: Свиђа ми се овај [дѐзен] на тканини.
examples.en: I like this pattern on the fabric.

examples.sr: Имате ли ову кошуљу у другом [де̏зену]?
examples.en: Do you have this shirt in a different pattern?
After the extermination there are no more cockroaches.
Call a service for insect control in the apartment.
At the border we fill out a customs declaration.
Sign the declaration at the end.

examples.sr: На радионици смо учили [деку̀паж] на јајима.
examples.en: At the workshop we learned decoupage on eggs.
This box is decorated with decoupage.

note: a napkin print is transferred onto an egg or a box

examples.en: A Red Cross delegate arrived this morning.
Twenty delegates came to the meeting.
A delta formed at the river mouth.
Many birds live in the delta.
Before the move, the bed has to be taken apart.
Dismantling the old water heater is free.
I booked a leg hair removal appointment.
I don't find hair removal pleasant.
The city landfill is full.
The waste is taken to the landfill.
The cat is clawing the armchair.
They fleece people at that restaurant.
Why are you yelling at me?
The neighbors are yelling all day.
The city regularly carries out rodent control in basements.
Rodent extermination is done twice a year.
In our family everyone is right-handed.
He talked about migration like a right-winger.
She found a four-leaf clover.
The sheep are grazing on clover.
We've run out of dish detergent.
Add a little detergent to the water.
The children are playing in the yard.
We have three children.

note: collective, takes neuter agreement: «деца су дошла»; sg. is «дете»

examples.en: I drank two deciliters of cold juice.
He ordered three deciliters of wine.
There is a playground nearby.
This is the children's room.
I have a date tonight.
How did your date go?

note: colloq., an anglicism; the neutral word is «састанак»

examples.en: Division by zero is not allowed.
We learned division with a remainder.
I forgot everything completely.
He was left totally without money.
In the fairy tale a giant lives in the mountains.
That basketball player is a real giant.
Give me the calculator, I need to add something up.
The kids are doing sums on a calculator.
Do you have a jack in the car?
A big crane stands next to the building.

note: «ручна дизалица» is a hand jack; on a building site «дизалица» is a crane

examples.en: Please fill it with twenty liters of diesel.
My car runs on diesel.
We have a dictation today.
I don't accept anyone's diktat.
I like smoked meat.
There is smoked bacon on the table.
Smoke is coming out of the chimney.
Storks build a nest on the chimney.
This costs fifty dinars.
I don't have a single dinar in my pocket.

note: after 2-4 and 5+ the form is «динара»: два динара, пет динара

examples.en: Onions should be gently stewed over low heat.
The meat stews for an hour.
I don't have a penny.
Give me a few dinars for coffee.
I have three diopters in my left eye.
How many diopters do you have?

examples.sr: [Дѝректорка] школе је позвала родитеље на састанак.
examples.en: The school principal invited the parents to a meeting.
The new director started last week.
One key on the piano got stuck.
She gently pressed the key.
Be discreet and don't tell anyone.
She wears understated jewelry.
Discrimination at work is prohibited.
He fights against all discrimination.
Colleagues are discussing the new project.
I don't want to argue with him.
The soldiers are disciplined.
He is a disciplined worker.
I'm not proud of that act.
He takes pride in his children.
The child has a fever and diarrhea.
If diarrhea lasts longer, see a doctor.
In summer I like a cold melon.
We bought a sweet melon at the market.
The stonecutter works with a chisel.
I need a chisel for wood.

examples.sr: Не могу да [доба̀цим] лопту до тебе.
examples.en: I can't throw the ball as far as you.

examples.sr: Из публике му је неко [до̀бацио] увреду.
examples.en: Someone in the audience shouted an insult at him.

note: «немој да ми добацујеш» means stop making remarks at me

examples.en: The boy is beating the drum.
Drums were played at the parade.
He's a real good soul, he helps everyone.

examples.sr: Моја тетка је [до̀брица] и никад не виче.
examples.en: My aunt is a good soul and never yells.

note: for a person of either gender

examples.en: Our neighbor is a good-natured old man.

examples.sr: Насмејао се [добро̀душно] и пустио нас унутра.
examples.en: He smiled good-naturedly and let us in.
Our dog is very good-natured.
He is a good-natured man.
I can drive you to the station.
He drove the kids to school.
Smoking is allowed here.
What is the permitted baggage weight?
Follow the dosage in the instructions.
The doctor determines the dosage of the medicine.
It's boring beyond belief.
She was dead tired.
I haven't gotten my PhD yet.
He got a PhD in history.
We received your letter on Monday.
We will reply to the letter in writing.

note: a business letter; a personal one is «писмо»

examples.en: We've been writing to each other for a month.
I like to correspond with friends.
I sent a postcard from Belgrade.
We bought stamps and postcards.

note: a picture postcard of a city is «разгледница»

examples.en: For more luggage you have to pay extra.

examples.sr: Хоћу собу са погледом, па ћу [допла́тити].
examples.en: I want a room with a view, so I'll pay extra.
Music contributes to maintaining mental health.
Advances in medicine contributed to population growth.

tips: Imperfective: доприносити. Government: допринети чему (dat.), e.g. допринети успеху. English "contribute to" has a preposition, but Serbian uses only the dative.

examples.en: I have to top up the credit on my phone.
Would you like us to add to your answer?
We need to refine the project a little more.
The company refined the new model.
He isn't up to this job.
I think you'll be up to the task.

note: no preposition, takes the dative: «дорасти нечему»

examples.en: I always have breakfast at seven.
Have we already had breakfast?
I was bored in class.
The kids are bored without TV.

examples.sr: Мој деда је био [досељѐнӣк] у Војводини.
examples.en: My grandfather was a settler in Vojvodina.

examples.sr: У селу живе стари мештани и [досељени́ци].
examples.en: Old residents and newcomers live in the village.
He is consistent in his views.
A consistent pricing policy is needed.
This money won't be enough for the rent.
Will there be enough food for everyone?

note: «доста» means enough; to reach with one's hand is «дохватити»

examples.en: She was always well-groomed and nicely dressed.
He came to the meeting all dressed up.

related.en: to tidy oneself up, to spruce up

examples.en: I barely made it to bed.
They barely made it to the exit.

examples.sr: Он је у граду још увек [до̀шља̄к].
examples.en: In the city he's still an outsider.
The new neighborhood was founded by newcomers.

note: slightly derogatory; in Vojvodina the ruder «дођош»

examples.en: The old-timers call us newcomers.
He's a newcomer from Bosnia.
Admittedly, I wasn't indifferent.
It's expensive, admittedly, but it's worth it.
Doctors recommend breastfeeding for the first six months.
You need to drink enough water while breastfeeding.
She is still breastfeeding the baby.
The doctor advises that you breastfeed.
The doctor examined the left breast.
A mammogram examines both breasts.
Grandpa chops firewood for the winter.
The stove is heated with wood.

note: plural only in the sense of «firewood»

examples.en: The street has a beautiful row of lindens.
We walk along the tree-lined path by the river.

note: дрво + ред: a row of trees

examples.en: I've been standing at the door all evening.
Don't loiter here, go home.

note: colloq.: to wait for a long time, usually in vain

examples.sr: Бака прича да [дрѐкавац] живи на гробљу.
examples.en: Grandma says a drekavac lives in the cemetery.
The children were afraid of the drekavac.

note: a scary creature of Balkan folklore

examples.en: Grandpa is dozing in the armchair.
Don't doze off at work.
After lunch I had a short nap.
I nodded off over my book.
He put on the red-and-white jersey.
I bought a jersey of my favorite player.
I'm a foreign citizen.
Every citizen has rights.
I'm applying for Serbian citizenship.
Documents are needed for citizenship.
That scoundrel cheated me.
Don't hang around with that scoundrel.

note: colloq.; an insult, but not vulgar

examples.en: My buddy works at a bank.
Tonight I'm going out with my buddies.
Our friendship has lasted since childhood.
Friendship is more important than money.
She is a very friendly person.

examples.sr: С њим је лако радити, јер је [дружељу̀бив].
examples.en: He's easy to work with because he's friendly.
That crowd from school is no more.
The whole gang went on a trip together.
Merchants once traveled along this road.
We set out on the road.

note: literary or archaic: «друм» is a main road

examples.en: I was seized by a chill.
A fever brings chills.
His hands were shaking from the cold.
Her voice trembles with excitement.
